items.title: Genome-scale perturbation signatures from primary human CD4+ T cells improve genetics-based prioritization of immune drug targets
items.abstract_or_text: While human genetic evidence improves drug program success, target selection largely relies on associational features. Even functional features are mainly observational, capturing disease associations rather than the consequence of perturbing genes in the disease-relevant human cell type. To move beyond association, we present IGNITE (Immune Genomics and fuNctional Integration for Target Enrichment), a framework that prioritizes immune drug targets by integrating human genetic priors with features from genome-scale perturb-seq in 22 million primary human CD4+ T cells and polarized T-helper subset differential expression. IGNITE is a semi-supervised machine learning model that applies positive-unlabeled learning to approved immune targets, then ranks 19,502 protein-coding genes to prioritize new candidates. In 727 in-trial genes held out from training, functional genomics increased target enrichment among the top 50 nominations from 2.7- to 4.8-fold for immune trial targets at any phase, and from 4.5- to 5.9-fold for targets in Phase III. These performance gains were immune-specific, as IGNITE outperformed genetic comparators on predicting immune-exclusive targets but not on cardiac-exclusive targets. Using temporal validation with labels frozen in 2014, IGNITE outperformed the genetics-only model in ranking 134 genes that subsequently entered immune trials. The functional genomics layer also surfaced two novel, pharmacologically tractable candidates, ELOVL6 and RUVBL1, elevating their rankings from outside the top 1,000 into the top 50. These findings highlight that perturbational signatures in the disease-relevant human cell type harbor target-relevant signals beyond human genetics, offering a generalizable route to indication-specific prioritization as perturbation atlases expand. Full IGNITE scores are publicly available at https://ignite.eecs.umich.edu/
items.summary_zh: IGNITE 整合 2,200 万原代人 CD4+ T 细胞的 Perturb-seq 特征与人类遗传学先验，用于免疫药物靶点排序，并在时间冻结验证中优于仅遗传学模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模、疾病相关细胞类型的扰动数据为靶点优先级提供了超出关联性遗传特征的补充信息，但 ELOVL6 和 RUVBL1 仍是待验证候选。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管人类遗传学证据可提高药物项目的成功率，靶点选择在很大程度上仍依赖关联性特征。即使功能特征也主要是观察性的，捕捉的是疾病关联，而不是在疾病相关人类细胞类型中扰动基因的后果。为超越关联，我们提出 IGNITE（Immune Genomics and fuNctional Integration for Target Enrichment），这是一个通过整合人类遗传学先验与来自 2,200 万个原代人 CD4+ T 细胞的全基因组规模 Perturb-seq 以及极化 T-helper 亚群差异表达特征来优先排序免疫药物靶点的框架。IGNITE 是一个半监督机器学习模型，对已获批免疫靶点应用正例-未标记学习，随后对 19,502 个蛋白编码基因排序以优先确定新候选。在训练中留出的 727 个处于临床试验中的基因中，功能基因组学使任意阶段免疫试验靶点在前 50 项提名中的靶点富集从 2.7 倍提高到 4.8 倍，并使 Phase III 靶点的富集从 4.5 倍提高到 5.9 倍。这些性能增益具有免疫特异性：IGNITE 在预测仅限免疫系统的靶点时优于遗传学比较模型，但在预测仅限心脏的靶点时并非如此。采用标签冻结于 2014 年的时间验证时，IGNITE 在排序后来进入免疫试验的 134 个基因方面优于仅遗传学模型。功能基因组学层还提出了两个新的、具有药理学可操作性的候选 ELOVL6 和 RUVBL1，将它们的排名从前 1,000 名之外提升至前 50 名。这些发现强调，疾病相关人类细胞类型中的扰动特征包含超出人类遗传学的靶点相关信号；随着扰动图谱扩展，这为适应症特异性的优先排序提供了一条可推广的路径。完整 IGNITE 分数可在 https://ignite.eecs.umich.edu/ 获取。

items.title: Safety, Immunogenicity, Antibody Persistence, and Booster Responses of an Animal-Component-Free Vero Cell Rabies Vaccine: A Randomized, Active-Controlled Phase III Trial.
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Eliminating animal-source additives from vaccine manufacture may reduce dependence on variable biological raw materials and the theoretical risk of adventitious-agent or extraneous-protein contamination. This study aimed to assess the safety and immunogenicity of an animal-component-free, antibiotic-free, freeze-dried human rabies vaccine (Vero Cell) with the "Essen" regimen and boosted two doses in China. Methods 1,200 healthy participants aged 10–60 years were randomized into two groups to receive the test vaccine or a licensed freeze-dried human Rabies Vaccine (Vero Cell) with the five doses Essen regimen. Two prespecified test-vaccine subcohorts received two booster doses with 3 days interval at month 3 or month 12 after primary Essen regimen respectively. Blood samples for immunogenicity assessment were collected pre-vaccination, on day 7 and 14 following the first dose, and day 14 and months 3, 6, and 12 following the final dose of the primary regimen. Additionally, samples were obtained before (months 3 or 12 respectively) and after two doses booster regimen. Rabies virus-neutralizing antibody (RVNA) concentrations were measured by the rapid fluorescent focus inhibition test (RFFIT). Safety observation was conducted during 30 days after each vaccination. Serious adverse event (SAE) was conducted throughout all the observation period. Results Out of 1,200 randomized participants, 596 in the test group and 600 in the control group included in the final safety analysis (SS). The test vaccine induced a significantly higher early seroconversion rate and geometric mean concentration (GMC) at Day 7 post-first dose. By Day 14 post-first dose and post-primary series, both groups achieved 100% seroconversion and comparable peak GMCs, with non-inferiority of the two groups. Over the 12-month persistence period, seroconversion rates remained high to 98% in both groups, with GMCs declining in parallel. Following a two-dose booster, both test-vaccine subgroups achieved 100% seropositivity by Day 14 post-booster. The reported adverse reactions (ARs) were primarily mild. No vaccine-related SAEs reported throughout the whole study period. Overall, the test vaccine demonstrated comparable immunogenicity, sustained antibody persistence, and a similar safety profile to the control vaccine. Conclusion The animal-component-free test human rabies vaccine (Vero Cell) induced non-inferior immunogenicity to the licensed vaccine following the primary Essen regimen, maintained RVNA responses at least one year, elicited robust responses to two-dose boosting even after a prolonged interval to 12 months. It exhibited a acceptable safety profile all through the whole period. These pivotal data establish the clinical performance of a manufacturing platform that avoids animal-source additives. Trial Registration: Prior to enrollment, the trial was registered with the Drug Clinical Trial Registration and Information Disclosure Platform in China (Registration No.: CXSL2010236). At the time of study initiation, registration in an ICMJE-approved registry was not required in our country, and the investigators were unaware of the ICMJE requirement. After completion of participant enrollment and before data analysis, the trial was registered with the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (Registration No.: ChiCTR2400089683). Before preparation of this manuscript, the trial was retrospectively registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT07672626). No changes were made to the primary outcome, eligibility criteria, or statistical analysis plan throughout these registration processes. We acknowledge that retrospective registration deviates from the ICMJE requirement for prospective registration and consider this a limitation of our study.
items.summary_zh: 一项 1,200 人随机、活性对照 Phase III 预印本显示，无动物源成分 Vero Cell 人用狂犬病疫苗的免疫原性不劣于对照，并报告一年抗体持续性和加强免疫反应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是入选项中临床证据最直接的研究之一，但研究注册为回顾性注册，且结果尚为预印本，不能替代正式监管或同行评议结论。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：从疫苗制造中去除动物源添加剂可能减少对可变生物原料的依赖，并降低外源因子或外来蛋白污染的理论风险。本研究旨在评估一种无动物源成分、无抗生素、冻干的人用狂犬病疫苗（Vero Cell）采用“Essen”程序及两剂加强免疫在中国的安全性和免疫原性。方法：将 1,200 名年龄 10–60 岁的健康参与者随机分为两组，接受试验疫苗或已获许可的冻干人用狂犬病疫苗（Vero Cell）的五剂 Essen 程序。两个预设的试验疫苗亚队列分别在初次 Essen 程序后第 3 个月或第 12 个月、间隔 3 天接受两剂加强免疫。于接种前、首剂后第 7 天和第 14 天、初次程序末剂后第 14 天及第 3、6 和 12 个月采集用于免疫原性评估的血液样本。此外，分别于加强程序前（第 3 或第 12 个月）和两剂加强程序后采集样本。采用快速荧光灶抑制试验（RFFIT）测定狂犬病病毒中和抗体（RVNA）浓度。每次接种后 30 天内进行安全性观察，整个观察期内监测严重不良事件（SAE）。结果：在 1,200 名随机受试者中，试验组 596 人、对照组 600 人纳入最终安全性分析（SS）。试验疫苗在首剂后第 7 天诱导出显著更高的早期血清转阳率和几何平均浓度（GMC）。至首剂后第 14 天及初次程序后，两组均达到 100% 血清转阳和可比的峰值 GMC，且两者具有非劣效性。在 12 个月持续期内，血清转阳率在两组中均维持在高达 98%，GMC 平行下降。两剂加强后，两个试验疫苗亚组均在加强后第 14 天达到 100% 血清阳性。报告的不良反应（AR）主要为轻度，整个研究期间未报告疫苗相关 SAE。总体而言，试验疫苗显示出与对照疫苗相当的免疫原性、持续的抗体持久性和相似的安全性特征。结论：无动物源成分的试验人用狂犬病疫苗（Vero Cell）在初次 Essen 程序后诱导的免疫原性不劣于已获许可疫苗，RVNA 应答至少维持一年，即使加强间隔延长至 12 个月后仍可对两剂加强产生强应答，并在整个期间显示出可接受的安全性特征。这些关键数据确立了避免动物源添加剂的制造平台的临床表现。试验注册：入组前，本研究已在中国药物临床试验登记与信息公示平台登记（登记号：CXSL2010236）。研究启动时，我国尚未要求在 ICMJE 认可的注册平台登记，研究者亦不了解 ICMJE 要求。参与者入组完成后、数据分析前，本研究在中国临床试验注册中心登记（登记号：ChiCTR2400089683）。在制备本稿前，本研究在 ClinicalTrials.gov 回顾性登记（NCT07672626）。在这些注册过程中，主要结局、入选标准或统计分析计划均未发生改变。我们承认回顾性注册偏离 ICMJE 的前瞻性注册要求，并将其视为本研究的局限性。

items.title: Transcriptome-wide mapping reveals a non-canonical RNA-dependent mechanism of platinum cancer drugs
items.abstract_or_text: Off-target interactions frequently compromise the clinical utility of anticancer agents by driving dose-limiting toxicity and therapeutic resistance. Although RNA has been predicted to be an off-target for numerous FDA-approved drugs, the extent and functional significance of RNA off-targeting among anticancer small molecules remain poorly understood. Using a systematic drug-binding screen, we identified cisplatin, a frontline chemotherapeutic that acts canonically through DNA adduct formation, as a prominent RNA binder. We employed cisplatin as a model compound to characterize the mechanistic basis and functional impact of RNA-small molecule off-targeting. To map transcriptome-wide cisplatin-RNA interactions, we developed PlatRNA-seq, a click-chemistry-enabled RNA-binding profiling platform. Genomic and functional analyses reveal that cisplatin preferentially accumulates at RNA G-quadruplex (rG4) structures near 5' transcript ends, inducing R-loop formation. Critically, we demonstrate that cisplatin cytotoxicity is partially mediated through RNA binding, revealing a noncanonical mechanism of action. Collectively, these findings illustrate the functional consequences of RNA-small-molecule off-targeting and provide a generalizable framework for investigating small-molecule-RNA interactions, opening new avenues for therapeutic innovation.
items.summary_zh: PlatRNA-seq 将顺铂的 RNA 结合定位到转录组范围，结果支持 RNA 结合可能部分介导其细胞毒性，并指向 rG4 与 R-loop 相关机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究以系统筛选、click chemistry 和功能分析拓展了小分子 RNA 脱靶的研究工具箱；其机制解释仍需在更多模型和临床情境中检验。
items.abstract_zh: 脱靶相互作用常通过造成剂量限制性毒性和治疗耐药而损害抗癌药物的临床效用。尽管 RNA 已被预测为许多 FDA 批准药物的脱靶对象，抗癌小分子 RNA 脱靶的范围及功能意义仍知之甚少。利用系统性药物结合筛选，我们鉴定出顺铂——一种经典通过形成 DNA 加合物发挥作用的一线化疗药——是一个显著的 RNA 结合物。我们以顺铂为模型化合物，表征 RNA-小分子脱靶的机制基础和功能影响。为绘制转录组范围的顺铂-RNA 相互作用，我们开发了由 click chemistry 赋能的 RNA 结合分析平台 PlatRNA-seq。基因组和功能分析显示，顺铂优先聚集于转录本 5' 端附近的 RNA G-quadruplex（rG4）结构，并诱导 R-loop 形成。关键的是，我们证明顺铂细胞毒性部分由 RNA 结合介导，揭示了一种非经典作用机制。总体而言，这些发现说明了 RNA-小分子脱靶的功能后果，并提供了一个用于研究小分子-RNA 相互作用的可推广框架，为治疗创新开辟了新途径。
items.author_line: Krishnaraj, A., Wei, X., Thakral, R., Guo, W., Subramanian, S. B., Zhang, X., Alley, K. R., Feng, A., Hoy, A., Kung, D., Tiwari, P. B., Uren, A., Maillard, R., DeRose, V. J., Nair, S. J.

items.title: LucaCell: a sequence-centric foundation model for cross-species single-cell analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models have transformed transcriptomic analysis, yet most rely on fixed gene identifiers that limit transfer across species and data types. Here we present LucaCell, a sequence-centric foundation model that represents genes through pre-trained mRNA sequence embeddings rather than static gene annotations. Gene expression is discretized into bins and modeled with a Transformer encoder, enabling sequence-informed cell representation without a fixed gene-ID vocabulary. Pre-training on 85 million human and mouse single cells, LucaCell is evaluated on human, mouse and lemur gene expression profiles, human chromatin accessibility data, unaligned reads from more than 50 prokaryotic taxa, and five influenza A virus genomes. LucaCell enables manual-mapping-free cross-species cell type annotation and an alignment-free microbial embedding framework that simultaneously distinguishes bacterial species identity and intra-species physiological states. It also improves gene expression reconstruction by incorporating donor-specific exonic SNP information into mRNA sequence embeddings, and predicts cellular viral load across influenza A virus strains while highlighting infection-like transcriptional states in mock-infected cells. These results show that sequence-informed gene representation can improve the generalization of single-cell foundation models across species, data types, and predictive tasks.
items.summary_zh: LucaCell 用 mRNA 序列嵌入替代固定基因 ID，并以 8,500 万人和小鼠单细胞预训练，评估跨物种、跨组学和微生物任务的泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 序列中心的表示有望减少跨物种单细胞分析中的人工同源基因映射依赖；全部性能结论目前仍来自预印本中的任务评估。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型已改变转录组分析，但大多数模型依赖固定的基因标识符，这限制了其在物种和数据类型之间的迁移。本文提出 LucaCell，这是一个以序列为中心的基础模型：它通过预训练的 mRNA 序列嵌入而非静态基因注释来表示基因。基因表达被离散化为分箱，并由 Transformer 编码器建模，从而无需固定的基因 ID 词表即可实现包含序列信息的细胞表示。LucaCell 在 8,500 万个人和小鼠单细胞上预训练，并在人、小鼠和狐猴基因表达谱、人类染色质可及性数据、超过 50 个原核分类群的未比对 reads，以及 5 个甲型流感病毒基因组上进行评估。LucaCell 能够实现无需人工映射的跨物种细胞类型注释，并提供一个无需比对的微生物嵌入框架，可同时区分细菌物种身份和种内生理状态。它还通过将供体特异性的外显子 SNP 信息纳入 mRNA 序列嵌入来改善基因表达重建，并预测不同甲型流感病毒株中的细胞病毒载量，同时在 mock-infected 细胞中突出显示感染样转录状态。这些结果表明，包含序列信息的基因表示可改善单细胞基础模型在物种、数据类型和预测任务之间的泛化。
items.author_line: Sun, Y., He, Y., Ren, M., Wang, Y., Xu, P., Hou, Y., Kang, Y., Hou, T., Ye, J., Yang, H., Wang, Z.

items.title: A foundation model learns the sequence and functional grammar of fully human heavy-chain-only antibodies
items.abstract_or_text: Antibody language models learn from large natural repertoires, but whether generic representations capture the constraints of specialized antibody formats remains unclear. We first characterized fully human heavy-chain-only antibodies (HCAbs) independently of HCAb-trained models. Source-aware comparisons with conventional human VH domains revealed a reproducible distributional shift localized predominantly to CDR1/2, CDR3 architecture and, where supported, a restricted framework region rather than widespread framework remodeling. These model-independent differences motivated repertoire-specific pretraining. We developed HCAbLM, to our knowledge the first foundation model pretrained specifically on a large-scale fully human HCAb repertoire, using 31.8 million sequences from 73 independently immunized HCAb mice. HCAbLM learned a region-selective sequence-compatibility prior distinct from conventional antibody language models, and its frozen representations transferred to experimentally measured SEC purity, HIC behavior and thermal stability in grouped internal validation and retrospective cross-project evaluation. These findings identify repertoire composition as an important biological design variable for foundation models of specialized antibody formats.
items.summary_zh: HCAbLM 在来自 73 只独立免疫 HCAb 小鼠的 3,180 万条全人源 HCAb 序列上预训练，并将冻结表示迁移至 SEC、HIC 和热稳定性实验测量。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把抗体库组成作为专用抗体基础模型的设计变量，并提供分组内部验证与跨项目回顾性评估；尚未证明其在前瞻性药物发现中的效用。
items.abstract_zh: 抗体语言模型从大型天然抗体库中学习，但通用表示能否捕捉专门抗体形式的约束仍不清楚。我们首先在不依赖 HCAb 训练模型的情况下表征全人源重链单域抗体（HCAbs）。与传统人源 VH 结构域进行的来源感知比较显示，可重复的分布偏移主要位于 CDR1/2、CDR3 架构，以及在证据支持时位于受限的框架区，而非广泛的框架区重塑。这些独立于模型的差异推动了抗体库特异性的预训练。我们开发了 HCAbLM，据我们所知，这是首个专门在大规模全人源 HCAb 抗体库上预训练的基础模型，使用了来自 73 只独立免疫 HCAb 小鼠的 3,180 万条序列。HCAbLM 学得了区别于传统抗体语言模型的区域选择性序列兼容性先验，其冻结表示可迁移至分组内部验证和回顾性跨项目评估中实验测得的 SEC 纯度、HIC 行为和热稳定性。这些发现表明，抗体库组成是专用抗体形式基础模型的重要生物学设计变量。
items.author_line: Nona Biosciences AI4S Team,, Miao, H.

items.title: DiffGSP: reversing mRNA diffusion to unlock high-fidelity spatial transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics enables gene expression profiling within intact tissues while preserving spatial context, providing unprecedented insights into cellular organization and function. However, mRNA diffusion during tissue processing can cause transcripts originating from adjacent cells to be captured at a given spot. This spatial misalignment challenges a fundamental premise of spatial transcriptomics that measured gene expression faithfully corresponds to its spatial origin, thereby compromising spatial fidelity and potentially biasing biological interpretation. Here, we present DiffGSP, a physics-informed framework that integrates Fick's law with graph signal processing to explicitly model diffusion-induced distortions and recover the underlying spatial gene expression landscape. Comprehensive benchmarking across diverse datasets and evaluation metrics demonstrates the consistent ability of DiffGSP to restore spatial gene expression patterns. By computationally reversing diffusion-induced distortions, DiffGSP enables the discovery of fine anatomical structures in the mouse brain, spatially organized gene modules in the kidney, intratumoral heterogeneity in colorectal cancer, and tertiary lymphoid structures in lung adenocarcinoma. Built on a physically interpretable framework and broadly applicable to sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics technologies, DiffGSP improves the fidelity of spatial gene expression reconstruction and enables more reliable biological interpretation.
items.summary_zh: DiffGSP 将 Fick 定律与图信号处理结合，显式建模并计算逆转空间转录组制样中的 mRNA 扩散失真。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 物理可解释的校正框架可能降低空间错配对组织结构和肿瘤异质性解释的影响，但其效果仍以计算基准为主。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学可在保留空间背景的完整组织内对基因表达进行分析，为细胞组织和功能提供前所未有的洞见。然而，组织处理过程中的 mRNA 扩散可能使源自相邻细胞的转录本在给定 spot 被捕获。这种空间错配挑战了空间转录组测得的基因表达忠实对应其空间来源这一基本前提，损害空间保真度，并可能使生物学解释产生偏差。本文提出 DiffGSP，这是一个将 Fick 定律与图信号处理整合的物理信息框架，用于显式建模由扩散引起的失真并恢复潜在的空间基因表达图景。跨多样数据集和评价指标的综合基准显示，DiffGSP 能够持续恢复空间基因表达模式。通过计算逆转扩散诱导的失真，DiffGSP 可发现小鼠脑中的精细解剖结构、肾脏中空间组织化的基因模块、结直肠癌中的肿瘤内异质性以及肺腺癌中的三级淋巴结构。DiffGSP 建立在物理可解释框架上，且可广泛应用于基于测序的空间转录组技术，可提高空间基因表达重建的保真度并实现更可靠的生物学解释。
items.author_line: Liu, J., Sun, S., Xu, Y., Jiang, S., Cao, S., Li, G., Zhao, X., Liu, B.

items.title: Synthetic Echocardiograms from Diffusion Models in Rare Cardiovascular Disease
items.abstract_or_text: The limited availability of imaging data for uncommon cardiovascular phenotypes constrains the development of robust imaging models. We evaluated whether class-conditional diffusion models can generate synthetic transthoracic echocardiograms that improve downstream cardiac imaging tasks. The primary application was cardiac amyloidosis detection in a Duke University cohort using a two-step classifier, with external analyses using EchoNet-Dynamic for image-fidelity assessment and EchoNet-LVH for wall-thickness phenotype classification. The Duke cohort was partitioned at the patient-encounter level into 70\% training, 15\% validation, and 15\% test sets; generators were trained only on the training partition, augmentation levels were selected using validation AUROC, and final evaluation used held-out real test data. In the Duke all-view two-step analysis, adding synthetic images increased AUROC from 0.883 to 0.924, with an AUROC difference of 0.041 (95\% CI, 0.013--0.069); in EchoNet-LVH, AUROC increased from 0.832 to 0.864, with an AUROC difference of 0.032 (95\% CI, 0.021--0.044). Expert review found that synthetic images were sometimes difficult to identify as synthetic, but rated them lower for diagnostic adequacy. These findings suggest that diffusion-generated echocardiograms may provide a practical approach to augmenting limited training data for selected cardiac imaging tasks and motivate further evaluation across clinical settings.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以真实保留测试集评估类别条件扩散生成的超声心动图增广，在心脏淀粉样变检测和 EchoNet-LVH 中报告 AUROC 提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究采用患者就诊层级划分和真实图像测试集，提供了合成影像可能改善特定任务的证据；专家也认为合成图像诊断充分性较低，泛化仍待检验。
items.abstract_zh: 罕见心血管表型的影像数据有限，限制了稳健影像模型的开发。我们评估了类别条件扩散模型能否生成可改善下游心脏影像任务的合成经胸超声心动图。主要应用是在 Duke University 队列中利用两步分类器检测心脏淀粉样变，外部分析则使用 EchoNet-Dynamic 评估图像保真度，并使用 EchoNet-LVH 分类室壁厚度表型。Duke 队列按患者-就诊层级划分为 70% 训练集、15% 验证集和 15% 测试集；生成器仅在训练分区上训练，增广水平通过验证 AUROC 选择，最终评价使用保留的真实测试数据。在 Duke 全视图两步分析中，加入合成图像使 AUROC 从 0.883 提高至 0.924，AUROC 差值为 0.041（95% CI，0.013--0.069）；在 EchoNet-LVH 中，AUROC 从 0.832 提高至 0.864，AUROC 差值为 0.032（95% CI，0.021--0.044）。专家评审发现，合成图像有时难以被识别为合成图像，但其诊断充分性评分较低。这些发现表明，扩散模型生成的超声心动图可能为特定心脏影像任务中增广有限训练数据提供实用途径，并推动在不同临床环境中开展进一步评价。
items.author_line: Lyu, P., Henao, R., Kwee, L. C., Peng, F. Z., Vemulapalli, S., Shah, S. H., Khouri, M. G., Zhang, A.

items.title: Lifelong Invertebrate Chordate Central Nervous System Regeneration is Driven by a Migrating Pool of Conserved Neural Stem Cells Program
items.abstract_or_text: Adult central nervous systems (CNS) are generally constrained by limited cellular replacement. How regenerating organisms integrate structural maintenance with continuous, cyclic renewal remains unresolved. Here, we leverage the colonial chordate Botryllus schlosseri which completely resorbs and regenerates its entire CNS de novo weekly. Combining indexed single-cell sorting, Smart-seq3 sequencing, spatial mapping, and temporal deconvolution, our studies suggest that this continuous CNS renewal is mediated by an intrinsic pool of lineage-restricted neural stem cells. Single-cell analysis resolved a conserved SOX2/NOTCH1/NEUROG1 prospective progenitor continuum alongside mature excitability-defined neurons. Brain aging drives a phase-specific desynchronization of this regenerative program, inducing early hyper-activation followed by a sudden collapse. Finally, syngeneic transplantation and in vivo tracking show that neural-complex-derived cells persist after vascular delivery and localize to developing bud and neural-associated territories, with injury-associated accumulation near the neural gland. This work establishes a spatiotemporal framework for lifelong chordate CNS renewal and aging.
items.summary_zh: 研究结合单细胞、空间和移植追踪，描述 Botryllus schlosseri 周期性 CNS 再生中与 SOX2/NOTCH1/NEUROG1 相关的祖细胞连续谱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该脊索动物系统为研究长期 CNS 更新与衰老提供了具时空分辨率的模型；文中的驱动机制主要仍是实验支持的推断。
items.abstract_zh: 成年中枢神经系统（CNS）通常受限于有限的细胞替换。再生生物如何将结构维持与持续、周期性的更新整合起来仍未解决。本文利用群体脊索动物 Botryllus schlosseri；其整个 CNS 每周均会完全吸收并从头再生。结合索引单细胞分选、Smart-seq3 测序、空间定位和时间去卷积，我们的研究提示，这种持续 CNS 更新由一个内在的、谱系受限的神经干细胞池介导。单细胞分析解析出一个保守的 SOX2/NOTCH1/NEUROG1 前瞻性祖细胞连续谱，以及成熟的、由兴奋性特征定义的神经元。脑衰老驱动这一再生程序发生阶段特异性的去同步化，先引起早期过度激活，继而突然崩溃。最后，同基因移植和体内追踪显示，神经复合体来源的细胞在血管输送后持续存在，并定位于发育中的芽和神经相关区域；在损伤相关条件下，它们在神经腺附近积累。本工作为终生脊索动物 CNS 更新和衰老建立了一个时空框架。
items.author_line: Anselmi, C., Levy, T., Yu, J. C., Ishizuka, K. J., Palmeri, K. J., Liu, D. D., Sinha, R., Voskoboynik, Y., Corridori, C., Neff, N. F., Detweiler, A. M., Weissman, I. L., Martello, G., Voskoboynik, A.

items.title: scACORN: Context-engineered agent orchestration of specialized small language models for single-cell transcriptomic interpretation
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell atlases now exceed 66 million cells, but turning a ranked expression profile and a free-form biological question into a reliable, evidence-grounded answer remains unsolved. Scaling a single model does not resolve this, because single-cell interpretation is a heterogeneous family of tasks whose correct answer depends on tissue, cohort, perturbation and annotation resolution. Here we present scACORN, an agentic alternative to monolithic single-cell language models that combines specialized small language models with context-engineered agent orchestration for their selection and composition at inference time. Each expert is built in two stages: domain-aligned contrastive adaptation fits a pretrained cell-to-text backbone to the transcriptomic geometry of a target dataset, and geometry-preserving specialization learns question-conditioned biological completions without eroding that geometry. A fixed orchestrating language model agent then selects and combines experts under a natural-language playbook that is itself optimized from textual feedback, with no gradient updates to the orchestrator. Across 10 Tabula Sapiens tissues, domain alignment raised transfer macro-F1 from 0.36 to 0.64 and Recall@5 from 0.87 to 0.97; specialized experts reached 0.89 mean exact-match annotation accuracy; and playbook optimization reduced unsupported gene citations from 14.5% to 3.5%. Our findings support specialization and orchestration as complementary responses to the heterogeneity and evidentiary demands of single-cell analysis.
items.summary_zh: scACORN 以专用小语言模型和固定编排 LLM 解释单细胞转录组；在 10 个 Tabula Sapiens 组织中报告迁移与证据引用指标提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该设计将模型专门化与可审计回答的编排分开，直接面对单细胞问答的组织和队列异质性；指标仍需独立复现与生物学专家评估。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞图谱现在已超过 6,600 万个细胞，但如何将一个排序后的表达谱和一个自由形式的生物学问题转化为可靠、以证据为基础的回答仍未解决。扩展单一模型不能解决这一问题，因为单细胞解释是一类异质性任务，其正确答案取决于组织、队列、扰动和注释分辨率。本文提出 scACORN，这是一种相对于单体式单细胞语言模型的智能体替代方案；它将专用小语言模型与上下文工程化的智能体编排结合，用于在推理时选择和组合模型。每个专家分两阶段构建：领域对齐的对比适配将预训练 cell-to-text backbone 拟合到目标数据集的转录组几何结构，保留几何结构的专门化则学习问题条件化的生物学补全，同时不侵蚀该几何结构。固定的编排语言模型智能体随后在一个由文本反馈优化的自然语言 playbook 下选择和组合专家，且不对编排器进行梯度更新。在 10 个 Tabula Sapiens 组织中，领域对齐将迁移 macro-F1 从 0.36 提高到 0.64，并将 Recall@5 从 0.87 提高到 0.97；专门化专家达到 0.89 的平均精确匹配注释准确率；playbook 优化将缺乏支持的基因引用从 14.5% 降至 3.5%。我们的发现支持将专门化和编排视为应对单细胞分析异质性和证据需求的互补策略。
items.author_line: Rasti-Meymandi, A., Nahali, S., Paramithiotis, E., Cheung, A. M., Dolatabadi, E.

items.title: Multiphoton tomographic fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy -TomoFLIM
items.abstract_or_text: Fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy provides quantitative, concentration-independent contrast for probing molecular interactions, biochemical environments and cellular physiology. However, the requirement to acquire sufficient time-resolved photon statistics makes FLIM inherently slow, limiting its application to dynamic biological processes. In live-cell applications, including calcium signalling and vesicular trafficking, acquisition times can exceed the timescale of the underlying biology, causing temporal averaging, motion artefacts and loss of transient information. Methods that increase FLIM acquisition speed while preserving quantitative lifetime accuracy are therefore required. We report on a high-speed, compressive, multiphoton fluorescence lifetime imaging technique (TomoFLIM). Two-photon fluorescence is excited using a line focus projected tomographically across the sample, while time-tagged fluorescence is acquired using time-correlated single-photon counting. Time-resolved fluorescence data are reconstructed using Lucy-Richardson deconvolution followed by a computationally efficient centre-of-mass method lifetime estimator. In addition, TomoFLIM Net, a physics-informed neural-network, directly reconstructs fluorescence intensity and lifetime from compressed time-resolved tomographic data. TomoFLIM was benchmarked against raster-scanned fluorescence lifetime measurements using calibrated fluorescence lifetime beads and biological specimens. We demonstrate imaging at compression ratios exceeding 90%, with Pearson correlation coefficients above 80% relative to reference images. A raster-scanned FLIM dataset acquired in 60 s was reproduced using TomoFLIM in 3.75 s, representing a 16-fold increase in frame rate and equivalent reduction in accumulated dark counts. TomoFLIM Net recovered distinct experimental bead lifetime populations, demonstrating a direct route from compressed measurements to quantitative lifetime maps. TomoFLIM therefore offers significant potential for rapid live-cell imaging of dynamic biological processes, including deep within turbid biological specimens.
items.summary_zh: TomoFLIM 以压缩式双光子 FLIM 和物理信息神经网络重建寿命图，在基准中将 60 s 栅格扫描采集复现为 3.75 s。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法将光学采集与学习式重建结合，可能有利于动态活细胞成像；相关性与校准珠、样本基准并不等同于所有生物学场景下的定量准确性。
items.abstract_zh: 荧光寿命成像显微镜可提供与浓度无关的定量对比，用于探测分子相互作用、生化环境和细胞生理。然而，获取足够的时间分辨光子统计数据会使 FLIM 天生较慢，限制其应用于动态生物过程。在包括钙信号和囊泡运输在内的活细胞应用中，采集时间可能超过基础生物学过程的时间尺度，从而造成时间平均、运动伪影和瞬态信息丢失。因此，需要在保持定量寿命准确性的同时提高 FLIM 采集速度的方法。我们报道一种高速、压缩式、多光子荧光寿命成像技术（TomoFLIM）。使用投射到样本上的线焦点进行层析激发双光子荧光，同时用时间相关单光子计数采集时间标记荧光。时间分辨荧光数据通过 Lucy-Richardson 去卷积重建，随后使用计算效率高的质心方法寿命估计器。除此之外，物理信息神经网络 TomoFLIM Net 直接从压缩的时间分辨层析数据中重建荧光强度和寿命。TomoFLIM 以校准荧光寿命珠和生物学样本为对象，相对于栅格扫描荧光寿命测量进行基准测试。我们演示了压缩率超过 90% 的成像，相对于参考图像的 Pearson 相关系数高于 80%。以栅格扫描 FLIM 在 60 s 获得的数据集可由 TomoFLIM 在 3.75 s 重现，代表 16 倍的帧率提升和累积暗计数的等效降低。TomoFLIM Net 恢复了不同的实验珠寿命群体，展示了从压缩测量直接得到定量寿命图的路径。因此，TomoFLIM 在包括浑浊生物样本深部在内的动态生物过程中具有快速活细胞成像的显著潜力。
items.author_line: Collard, L., Jose, A. A., Rahman, F., Garcia-Aguirre, R., Treacy, C., Pallett, T., Culley, S., Ameer-Beg, S. M., Poland, S. P.

items.title: Profiling proteome-level amino acid substitutions in Alzheimer's disease brain tissue
items.abstract_or_text: As the most prevalent neurodegenerative disorder worldwide, Alzheimer's disease (AD) remains incompletely understood at the proteome level. In particular, current studies on amino acid (AA) substitutions have predominantly relied on genomic and transcriptomic profiling. Proteome-scale AA substitutions remain largely uncharacterized. Nevertheless, alterations at the DNA and RNA levels cannot fully recapitulate the spectrum of AA substitutions observed at the proteome level. This critical research gap persists largely due to the inherent analytical challenges posed by large-scale proteomic datasets. In this study, we address this limitation by analyzing two independent AD proteomic datasets, AMP-AD and PXD013753, using PIPI-C, an open-search mass spectrometry engine capable of resolving multiple co-occurring modifications per peptide. We introduce a pipeline that enables the characterization of AA substitutions at the proteome level and the dissection of regulatory functions of key proteins with such substitutions. In both datasets, we observe that, after controlling for ambiguous post-translational modification mass shifts, the N>M substitution is the most frequent variant among N>X substitutions in the AD data. Furthermore, among the 701 overlapping proteins shared by the two datasets, we identified 6 literature-reported substitution sites, including residues 242 and 352 in glial fibrillary acidic protein, site 370 in actin gamma 1, as well as sites 111, 115, and 116 in hemoglobin subunit beta. Since most reported AA substitutions rely on genomic or transcriptomic evidence, and our pipeline adopts rigorous false-positive controls, those unreported substitutions are presumably detectable only via proteomic methods, emphasizing the unique value of our proteome-based substitutomics workflow for AD research.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 PIPI-C 对两个独立 AD 蛋白组数据集进行开放搜索，建立蛋白组尺度氨基酸替换分析流程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该流程尝试将 DNA/RNA 层面难以覆盖的替换信号纳入 AD 蛋白组研究，并对歧义 PTM 质量位移进行控制；未报告替换的生物学来源仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 作为全球最常见的神经退行性疾病，Alzheimer's disease（AD）在蛋白组层面仍未被充分理解。特别是，当前对氨基酸（AA）替换的研究主要依赖基因组和转录组分析。蛋白组尺度的 AA 替换仍在很大程度上未被表征。然而，DNA 和 RNA 层面的改变不能完全重现蛋白组层面观察到的 AA 替换谱。这一关键研究空白主要持续存在于大规模蛋白组数据集固有的分析挑战。在本研究中，我们使用能够解析每条肽上多种共现修饰的开放搜索质谱引擎 PIPI-C，分析两个独立 AD 蛋白组数据集 AMP-AD 和 PXD013753，以解决这一限制。我们引入了一条流程，可在蛋白组层面表征 AA 替换，并解析带有此类替换的关键蛋白的调控功能。在两个数据集中，我们观察到：在控制歧义的翻译后修饰质量位移后，N>M 替换是 AD 数据中 N>X 替换里最常见的变异。此外，在两个数据集共享的 701 个重叠蛋白中，我们鉴定出 6 个文献已报道替换位点，包括 glial fibrillary acidic protein 的第 242 和 352 位残基、actin gamma 1 的第 370 位点，以及 hemoglobin subunit beta 的第 111、115 和 116 位点。由于大多数已报道 AA 替换依赖基因组或转录组证据，而我们的流程采用严格的假阳性控制，那些未报道的替换推测只能通过蛋白组方法检测，强调了我们面向 AD 研究的蛋白组 substitutomics 流程的独特价值。

items.title: Regional choroid plexus calcifications and their associations with aging, brain structure, and disease
items.abstract_or_text: The choroid plexus (CP) maintains brain homeostasis through cerebrospinal fluid production and formation of the blood-cerebrospinal fluid barrier, and its dysfunction has been linked with aging and neurological disease. CP dysfunction may involve both enlargement and calcific tissue change, which may reflect distinct processes; yet population neuroimaging has focused on lateral ventricle CP volume, which cannot directly identify calcified tissue. Using quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) in 30,012 UK Biobank participants, we conducted, to our knowledge, the first large scale multi-ventricular study of CP calcification (CPcal), quantifying the lateral (LV), third (3rdV) and fourth (4thV) ventricles. We examined associations with age and sex, endocrine, nutritional and metabolic, mental and behavioral, nervous system, and circulatory diagnoses; family history of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD); cardiometabolic traits; and brain macrostructure, white matter microstructure, and subcortical susceptibility. CPcal increased with age (largest association: LV, r = 0.191) and was greater in males in the LV and 3rdV (d = 0.249-0.359) and more prevalent in the 4thV (OR = 1.274). Greater CPcal was associated with endocrine and metabolic, psychiatric, nervous system, and circulatory disorders, with the strongest and most consistent associations observed in the 3rdV (d = 0.097 - 0.125) and persisted after adjustment for ventricular volume, particularly for diabetes (d = 0.303) and tobacco use disorder (d = 0.314). Maternal ADRD family history was associated with greater LV CPcal (d = 0.063). CPcal was also associated with cortical and subcortical volumes (r = 0.033 - 0.046), white matter microstructure (r = 0.017 - 0.042), and subcortical susceptibility (r = -0.064 - 0.131). QSM-derived CPcal is a scalable, radiation-free imaging phenotype that complements volumetry by characterizing calcific CP tissue, which is associated with cardiometabolic health, brain aging, and neurodegenerative risk, particularly in the third ventricle.
items.summary_zh: 基于 30,012 名 UK Biobank 参与者的 QSM 分析显示，脉络丛钙化与年龄、脑结构及多类疾病诊断存在小至中等的关联。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该大样本人群影像研究提出无辐射的脉络丛钙化表型；研究为横断面关联分析，不能据此推断钙化导致疾病或脑老化。
items.abstract_zh: 脉络丛（CP）通过产生脑脊液和形成血液-脑脊液屏障维持脑稳态，其功能障碍与衰老和神经系统疾病相关。CP 功能障碍可能同时涉及增大和钙化组织变化，这两者可能反映不同过程；但人群神经影像研究一直聚焦于侧脑室 CP 体积，不能直接识别钙化组织。我们在 30,012 名 UK Biobank 参与者中使用定量磁敏感成像（QSM），开展了据我们所知首个大规模多脑室 CP 钙化（CPcal）研究，量化侧脑室（LV）、第三脑室（3rdV）和第四脑室（4thV）。我们考察了与年龄和性别、内分泌、营养和代谢、精神和行为、神经系统及循环系统诊断、Alzheimer's disease and related dementias（ADRD）家族史、心代谢性状以及脑大体结构、白质微结构和皮质下磁敏感性的关联。CPcal 随年龄增加而增加（最大关联：LV，r = 0.191），且男性在 LV 和 3rdV 中更高（d = 0.249-0.359），在 4thV 中更常见（OR = 1.274）。更高的 CPcal 与内分泌和代谢、精神、神经系统和循环系统疾病相关，其中 3rdV 中的关联最强且最一致（d = 0.097 - 0.125）；在对脑室体积调整后仍持续存在，尤其是糖尿病（d = 0.303）和烟草使用障碍（d = 0.314）。母系 ADRD 家族史与更高的 LV CPcal 相关（d = 0.063）。CPcal 还与皮质和皮质下体积（r = 0.033 - 0.046）、白质微结构（r = 0.017 - 0.042）和皮质下磁敏感性（r = -0.064 - 0.131）相关。QSM 衍生的 CPcal 是一种可扩展、无辐射的影像表型，通过表征钙化 CP 组织补充体积测量；它与心代谢健康、脑衰老和神经退行性风险相关，尤其在第三脑室中如此。
items.author_line: Ba Gari, I., Zhu, A., Bhatt, R. R., Nir, T. M., Jahanshad, N.

items.title: stably: error-controlled stability selection for biomarker panel discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Motivation Data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry (DIA-MS) has become increasingly popular for clinical proteomics due to its sensitivity and reproducibility. Univariate statistical analysis tools, such as limma and MSstats, are widely used for identifying differentially abundant proteins but cannot capture multivariate relationships between proteins that may provide greater discriminatory power as a panel. Machine learning approaches can address this gap, but typically prioritise predictive performance over feature stability, producing biomarker panels for downstream validation that vary depending on data splitting and are poorly suited to clinical translation. Results We developed stably, a Python package that implements stability selection with formal false positive control for DIA proteomics data. Using synthetic data with known ground-truth biomarkers, we show that the Shah and Samworth complementary pairs stability selection framework recovers more true synthetic biomarkers than the Meinshausen and Buhlmann framework at moderate effect sizes typical of proteomics (d = 0.5 - 2.0), while both maintain false positive rates well below their theoretical guarantees. Applied to a publicly available serum proteomics dataset from patients with all stages of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (n=176), stably identified a stable 17-protein biomarker panel in the discovery cohort (n=120), which achieved higher predictive power (AUC = 0.93) in the validation cohort (n=56) than the panel selected by Byeon et al. (2024)(AUC 0.82). stably represents a principled, error-controlled method for biomarker panel discovery for translation into second cohorts. Availability and implementation stably is available on GitHub (https://github.com/byrnedaniel5-eng/stably); the version used in this study is archived on PyPI (https://pypi.org/project/stably/).
items.summary_zh: stably 为 DIA-MS 蛋白质组学提供带形式化假阳性控制的稳定性选择；在胰腺导管腺癌血清队列中得到 17 蛋白面板。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法同时关注特征稳定性与验证集预测性能，并提供 GitHub/PyPI 实现；n=56 的验证队列仍不足以支持临床转化结论。
items.abstract_zh: 数据非依赖采集质谱（DIA-MS）因其灵敏度和可重复性而日益用于临床蛋白质组学。诸如 limma 和 MSstats 的单变量统计分析工具广泛用于鉴定差异丰度蛋白，但不能捕捉蛋白之间可能作为面板提供更强判别能力的多变量关系。机器学习方法可解决这一缺口，但通常优先考虑预测性能而非特征稳定性，产生的用于后续验证的生物标志物面板会随数据划分而变化，不适于临床转化。结果：我们开发了 stably，这是一个 Python 包，为 DIA 蛋白质组数据实现具有形式化假阳性控制的稳定性选择。使用具有已知真实生物标志物的合成数据，我们表明 Shah 和 Samworth 的互补对稳定性选择框架在蛋白质组学典型的中等效应量（d = 0.5 - 2.0）下比 Meinshausen 和 Buhlmann 框架恢复更多真实合成生物标志物，同时两者均将假阳性率维持在远低于其理论保证的水平。应用于来自所有分期胰腺导管腺癌患者的公开血清蛋白组数据集（n=176）时，stably 在发现队列（n=120）中鉴定出稳定的 17 蛋白生物标志物面板；该面板在验证队列（n=56）中达到比 Byeon et al.（2024）选择的面板更高的预测能力（AUC = 0.93，而后者 AUC 为 0.82）。stably 代表了一种有原则、具误差控制的生物标志物面板发现方法，可用于向第二队列转化。可用性和实现：stably 可在 GitHub（https://github.com/byrnedaniel5-eng/stably）获取，研究所用版本已归档于 PyPI（https://pypi.org/project/stably/）。
items.author_line: Byrne, D., McNamara, M., Unwin, R.

items.title: HeartVar: An LLM-Assisted Tool for Clinical Classification of Variants in Cardiovascular Disease Cohorts
items.abstract_or_text: Manual clinical DNA variant classification is the bottleneck of every clinical and research rare disease workflow. The process typically requires a curator to assemble evidence from numerous databases, weigh 28 criteria, reconcile competing evidence, and produce a defensible case for the final classification. Additionally, the framework used to assess variants is not static and successive addenda have revised individual criteria. The most complete and current evidence aggregators available are commercial platforms, which can limit researcher access. We present HeartVar, an open-source web tool that automates the evidence-gathering and interpretation steps of variant classification associated with cardiovascular disease. Given a gene, a variant, and clinical context, HeartVar queries 20 public databases in parallel and assigns ACMG/AMP criteria through a hybrid rule-based/large language model (LLM) approach. Criteria that can be resolved from structured data are computed programmatically, and only those requiring interpretation of unstructured evidence are passed to the LLM. HeartVar returns a classification, point score, per-criterion breakdown, clinical-narrative summary, and database annotations. Benchmarking of 106 expert-curated ClinGen variants showed HeartVar outperformed other curation tools, assigning the correct ACMG tier in 72% of cases. HeartVar demonstrates that an LLM constrained by a domain-specific prompt and grounded in structured evidence can produce variant interpretations of first-pass quality for a cardiovascular disease cohort; however, it is not intended to replace manual assessment by a qualified variant curator. The tool is freely available to use and hosted at www.heartvar.victorchang.edu.au.
items.summary_zh: HeartVar 以规则与 LLM 协同汇集 20 个公开数据库证据，在 106 个 ClinGen 专家注释变异上获得 72% ACMG 分层正确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其输出可追溯到逐条 ACMG/AMP 证据，适合作为心血管变异解读的初筛辅助；作者明确说明不能取代合格人工遗传变异解读员。
items.abstract_zh: 人工进行临床 DNA 变异分类是每个罕见病临床和研究工作流的瓶颈。该过程通常要求人工解读员从众多数据库收集证据，权衡 28 项标准，协调相互冲突的证据，并为最终分类形成可辩护的案例。此外，用于评估变异的框架并非静态，连续的增补已修订个别标准。现有最完整、最新的证据聚合器是商业平台，这可能限制研究人员的访问。我们提出 HeartVar，这是一个开源网络工具，用于自动化心血管疾病相关变异分类的证据收集和解释步骤。给定基因、变异和临床背景，HeartVar 并行查询 20 个公开数据库，并通过混合的规则基础/大语言模型（LLM）方法分配 ACMG/AMP 标准。可由结构化数据解决的标准以程序方式计算，只有那些需要解释非结构化证据的标准才交给 LLM。HeartVar 返回分类、分值、逐项标准分解、临床叙述性摘要和数据库注释。在对 106 个专家解读的 ClinGen 变异进行的基准中，HeartVar 优于其他解读工具，在 72% 的病例中分配了正确的 ACMG 分层。HeartVar 表明，受领域特异性提示约束且以结构化证据为基础的 LLM，能够为心血管疾病队列生成初筛质量的变异解释；但它并不旨在取代由合格变异解读员进行的人工评估。该工具可免费使用，并托管于 www.heartvar.victorchang.edu.au。
items.author_line: Thompson, J.-L., Das, D., Dunwoodie, S. L., Giannoulatou, E.

items.title: Cell-level random splits leak group-owned answers in single-cell benchmarks
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning models in single-cell biology increasingly forecast differentiation, reprogramming and therapeutic response from early transcriptomic profiles. Testing whether a model has learned real biology requires held-out cells. Single-cell data, however, are grouped: cells from the same clone, patient or batch share the same label. A random split therefore places relatives of each test cell, carrying its label, in the training set, and a model can score well by memorizing a relative instead of learning a transferable rule. Grouped validation removes this leakage but leaves far fewer independent units behind each error bar. Here we show how to estimate this leakage before training any model, from two properties of the data: exposure, the fraction of test cells with relatives in training, and retrievability, how often a nearest-neighbor search returns such a relative rather than an unrelated cell. Across lineage-barcoded and patient data, exposure determines whether a random split opens a leakage channel, and retrievability determines how much it can inflate the score. The inflation is negligible where cell state has decoupled from ancestry, much larger where clonal sisters remain close in expression space, and in a patient cohort large enough to overturn a clinical conclusion. We also provide eakcheck, which computes both properties in seconds, before the outcome model is fitted.
items.summary_zh: 该研究量化单细胞随机划分中由克隆、患者或批次共享标签导致的信息泄漏，并提供训练前数秒可运行的 eakcheck 检测工具。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接针对单细胞预测基准常见的独立性假设问题；泄漏程度依赖数据中的暴露与可检索性，不能一概而论。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞生物学中的机器学习模型日益从早期转录组谱预测分化、重编程和治疗应答。检验模型是否学到了真实生物学需要保留的细胞。然而，单细胞数据具有分组结构：来自同一克隆、患者或批次的细胞共享相同标签。因此，随机划分会将每个测试细胞的、带有其标签的亲缘细胞置于训练集中，模型可能通过记忆亲缘细胞而非学习可迁移规则获得高分。分组验证消除了这种泄漏，但使每个误差条背后的独立单位大幅减少。本文展示如何在训练任何模型前，利用数据的两种性质估计这种泄漏：暴露度，即训练集中存在亲缘细胞的测试细胞比例；以及可检索性，即最近邻搜索返回此类亲缘细胞而非无关细胞的频率。在线系条形码和患者数据中，暴露度决定随机划分是否打开泄漏通道，可检索性决定其能在多大程度上抬高分数。当细胞状态已与祖先关系脱钩时，分数膨胀可忽略不计；当克隆姐妹在表达空间中仍彼此接近时，膨胀会大得多；而在一个患者队列中，其程度足以推翻一项临床结论。我们还提供 eakcheck，它可在拟合结局模型前数秒内计算这两种性质。

review.note: 从 60 项候选中选出 16 项；全部为 preprint，未将其表述为同行评议结论。已排除在目标日前归档中出现、且候选元数据未提供可核实新版本依据的重复身份条目。
